phrases: Indecision: heads nothing, tails poem about nothing; flesh melt or nap.
Usurp: swap hands; brother's murder, stronger guilt defeats intent.
Willful Ignorance: ignore Action effects; lady doth protest too much.
Haunt: discard highest card; father's spirit walk the night.
Verbose: uninterrupted talk; brevity soul of wit, tediousness limbs.
Distraction: sing song; know what we are, not what we may be.
Revenge: double damage against Hamlet; reveng'd, damnation.
Witness: narrate winner's victory; tell my story, absent felicity.
Memento Mori: discard Vanity; infinite jest, where be your gibes?
Expendable: discard to avoid damage; not near my conscience.
Guilt Trip: King card discarded; play catches King's conscience.
Accidental Death: pass left, lose HP; drink, I am poison'd.
Ambition: Power gained, cannot sleep; blood stepp'd in too far.
Coercion: force another to attack; out damned spot.
Prophecy: rearrange cards; double toil, trouble, cauldron bubble.
Guilt: most cards cannot play Actions; gory locks shake at me.
Not Born of Woman: Tyrant defeated; womb untimely ripp'd.
Innocence: attacker loses Reputation; poor bird, net and lime.
Comic Relief: pause game, everyone drink; sleep, urine and nose-painting.
Restoration: discard pile back into deck; country's purge.
Hallucination: failed attack on yourself; dagger before me.
Camouflage: units not targeted; wood comes toward Dunsinane.
Brew: weak cards into strong; baboon's blood, charm good.
Insomnia: no Rest or heal; murder innocent sleep.
Abdicate: give half cards, then scream; more sinn'd than sinning.
Truth Bomb: reveal hand, mock strategy; fool stays, wise flies.
Eviction: discard Home; boil, plague sore.
Cruelty: Blind opponent, face-down cards; prescribe not duty.
Despair: jump cliff or survive; no way, want no eyes.
Bastard's Ambition: lowest for highest card; gods stand up for bastards.
Disguise: no attacks target; foul fiend bites back.
Bluntness: cancel Flattery; occupation to be plain.
Cataclysm: discard cards; winds crack cheeks, rage.
Humiliation: next turn lost; Fortune ne'er turns key to poor.
Placebo: heal without anything happening; cliff altitude.
Tragic End: everyone loses; dog, horse, rat have life.
Infinite Variety: change rules; age cannot wither her.
Dotage: ignore responsibilities; triple pillar becomes fool.
Bureaucracy: tax players; fishes, drinks, wastes lamps.
Defection: switch alliances, die later; barge like burnish'd throne.
Fortune Telling: predict next card; marry three kings, widow them.
Third Wheel: nothing effective; what manner thing crocodile?
Self-Sacrifice: damage for Leader; escape Antony's sorrow.
Bad News: bearer damage; bad news infects teller.
Quick Exit: Character removed; sharp teeth untie life.
Retreat: flee battle; world lost with ignorance.
Siege: cannot attack or be attacked; lock yourself, word you are dead.
Debauchery: skip turn to party; judgments drop in filth.
A Plague on Both Houses: damage strongest; worms' meat.
Inception: false idea in opponent's hand; fairies' midwife in lovers' brains.
Illusion: cancel attack; nothing but vain fantasy.
Transport: discarded card to hand; joiner squirrel or old grub.
Game Over: most Tragedy points win; rest silence.
Sudden Death: player eliminated; gone for ever.
Encore: character back from dead; skull had tongue, could sing.
Chaos: all hands shuffled and redealt; Stay Fluffy, KayfaBINGO.
